items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] Minnie Ha Ha. And I don't know what he meant to have that copy yet.

ctx.x: Minnie Ha Ha. And I don't know what he meant to have that copy yet. And that was an arrangement that was all written by my father and my uncle. They didn't have, they just had a suit. They had, they just had a suit and copy of it. And that was written by them. They were married to Northern Ireland.
It seems to me more of the old time musicians, they all talk about your brother as, usually they refer to him as the most famous one of the clarinetists in the family.
